home.name: Guo Yang
home.role: Full-stack engineer · I make complex systems thin
home.bio1: I build things that survive production with TypeScript, Next.js and PostgreSQL. Mostly content systems, permission models, and backends that have to hold up under real traffic.
home.bio2: I like settling the edge cases before shipping, and leaving one small mechanism on a page that only I know the reason for.
home.statusTitle: Open to roles and freelance work
home.statusBody: Available for remote full-time and small-to-mid projects. Pick any star on the chart, or find me on the contact page.

about.title: Who I am, what I am building
about.p1: I am Guo Yang, a full-stack engineer seven years in. Most of that time went into content-driven products — CMS, permissions, search and ranking. The kind of work where the frontend has to feel good, the backend has to hold, and the data model cannot be sloppy on day one.
about.p2: I am pragmatic about the stack: Next.js end to end, Hono where an API needs to scale on its own, Prisma with PostgreSQL for data. Redis and queues where they earn their place, and no abstraction before it is needed.
about.p3: Outside work I write, maintain a toolkit I actually use, and run the occasional motion experiment. This site is one of them.
about.fireLabel: Decorative campfire. Move the mouse to sway the flames, click to stoke it.

contact.title: Contact
contact.note: The best fit is a small-to-mid project delivered end to end: a content site, an admin dashboard, or a system that needs third-party login and permissions. Per project or per week both work. If you already have designs and a defined scope, send them over.
